name: Hercules
subtitle: Mighty Redeemer
description: Complete Twelve Labors and Deal Devastating Damage to Enemies
lore: Olympus’s greatest hero and a god in his own right, Hercules stalks the monsters of Ryven, protecting his home realm from their depredations. Sadly, the altered magics of this world also render him susceptible to bouts of violent madness inspired by servants of Chaos, forcing him to isolate himself from those he loves and making his efforts an exercise in loneliness.
divinity_generator: Gain [500] Divinity when defeating an enemy.

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Awaken the ability: Zero to Hero
Barrier Multiplier +30%, DMG Reduction Multiplier +20%, Strong Hit DMG Multiplier +30%
Attunement Multiplier +50%, Armor Multiplier +30%, Weapon Multiplier +30%

skills.name: Olympian Might
skills.description: Increases Hercules' Attack by 20% and Health by 20%.
skills.awakening_bonus: Increases Hercules' Attack by 30% and Health by 30%. Also, at the start of battle, Hercules gains a [Cleanse] buff for 1 turn.

skills.name: Hydra Club
skills.description: Attack all enemies (12%HP+120%ATK) with a 75% chance to place [mechanic:acid] on each target for 2 turns.
skills.awakening_bonus: If the target is under [Acid] then reduce the target ATK by 5% (stacking up to 5 times).

skills.name: Nemean Lion Hide
skills.description: Attacks an enemy 1 time. Has a 50% chance to inflict [Defense Down I] on the target for 2 turns.
skills.awakening_bonus: Has a 75% chance to inflict [Defense Down I] on the target for 2 turns.

skills.name: Herc Smash
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy (18%HP+140%ATK) and place [mechanic:stun] for 1 turn. If this hero is under [mechanic:immortal], increase the damage inflicted by 100% and place [mechanic:stun] for 2 turns instead.

skills.name: Zero to Hero
skills.description: Prevents this hero’s death and heals them to 100% of their MAX HP.

skills.name: Herculean Strength
skills.description: Attacks all enemies 1 time. Has a 75% chance to inflict [mechanic:stun] on all enemies for 1 turn. Also grants self a [Counterattack] buff for 2 turns.
skills.awakening_bonus: Grants self [Counterattack] for 2 turns and a [Defense Up II] buff for 2 turns.

skills.name: Divine Resilience
skills.description: Whenever Hercules takes damage, he has a 50% chance to gain 10 Divinity. This effect can only trigger once per turn.
skills.awakening_bonus: Whenever Hercules takes damage, he has a 75% chance to gain 10 Divinity. This effect can only trigger once per turn.

skills.name: Nemean Lion Slayer
skills.description: Deals 260% ATK damage to an enemy. Has a 35% chance to inflict Burn for 2 turns.

skills.name: Hydra's Venom
skills.description: Deals 380% ATK damage to an enemy and has a 50% chance to inflict Poison for 2 turns. If the target is already Burned, this attack has a 100% chance to inflict Poison.

skills.name: Twelve Labors
skills.description: Increase this hero's HP by 5% (stacking up to 12 times) and place [mechanic:barrier]5%HP on this hero. When at max stacks, place [mechanic:immortal] on this hero for 1 turn.
skills.awakening_bonus: Also, increase this hero’s ATK by 5% (stacking up to 12 times).

skills.name: God Strength
skills.description: Increases Hercules's ATK by 20% and Crit Rate by 10%.

imprint_passive: Prevents this hero’s death and heals them to 50% of their MAX HP.
